info.name: TechRepublic WordPress REST Authors Posts API

params.name: per_page
params.description: Maximum number of items to be returned in result set.

params.name: search
params.description: Limit results to those matching a string.

params.name: after
params.description: Limit response to posts published after a given ISO 8601 date.

params.name: before
params.description: Limit response to posts published before a given ISO 8601 date.

params.name: categories
params.description: Limit result set to all items that have the specified term assigned in the categories taxonomy.

params.name: tags
params.description: Limit result set to all items that have the specified term assigned in the tags taxonomy.

params.name: author
params.description: Limit result set to posts assigned to specific authors.

params.name: order
params.description: Order sort attribute ascending or descending.

params.name: _embed
params.description: Embed linked resources in the response.

items.docs: Retrieve a collection of published posts from TechRepublic.
